provenance.note: The profile is not published on the payloads main branch, so the app cannot resolve it from the online manifest. The exploit/profile data come from PR #320 commit a311cb88c28204c3902af9450ae4077199e4d71d. EXPERIMENTAL v3.3.0: ksud is the e1q Phase-D pair from Root-My-Galaxy-Payloads commit 8236c84301282b5415412d867ab71d4a739e0809, built with CONFIG_KSU_SAMSUNG_NO_PATCH_TEXT=y and statically audited. One full-chain Shizuku-mode run succeeded on SM-S9210 with app 0.3.2-s24.1 on 2026-10-03; repeatability, Manager UI status, and resetprop checks remain unverified.
provenance.schemaVersionRationale: The online feed is owned upstream and pins remote artifacts by url; this file is owned by this repository and pins them by asset path plus digest, so the two are versioned independently rather than sharing one number that would describe two different shapes. Version 4 also carries fields the online feed has no use for: an exact kernelReleases gate, and a digest that replaces no upstream field.
provenance.requiresFreshP0SessionNote: The upstream manifest entry sets requiresFreshP0Session to true and that value is preserved here verbatim, but the app does not implement it and the bundled payload does not enforce it either: src/targets/e1q-S9210ZHS6DZG1/target.h does not define APP_REQUIRE_FRESH_P0_SESSION, so src/preload.c takes the branch that retains a discovered P0 offset and injects it into the next child. The porting record documents the env as EXPLOIT_ATTEMPTS=24 and separately reports the golden run completing on attempt 5/48; it does not contain a supervisor-retained diagnostic, so it does not establish that the retention branch was actually exercised. Treat this field as upstream metadata, not as a behavioural contract.
